C1567.title: Academic Research Reveals DNS Hijacking Attacks on DApp Frontends
C1567.summary: An academic paper on Web3 software supply chain security discusses security risks in DApp frontends and related dependency chains. Based only on the current page abstract, it should be treated as a Web3 software supply chain risk research case rather than directly asserting that the paper verified DNS hijacking replacing transaction addresses or injecting malicious code. DNS hijacking details should be supported by paper text excerpts if retained.

references.title: Software Supply Chain Security of Web3
